info.title: Queue OpenAPI for kling/v4/video-to-video/edit
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the kling/v4/video-to-video/edit queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Edit a video with Kling 4.0 Omni Video (the input is the base video)

elements.description: Characters/objects, referenced as @Element1, @Element2, ... (max 7). Up to 3 elements may carry a voice_id and up to 3 may be video elements.
elements.title: Elements

video_urls.description: Reference videos, referenced as @Video2, @Video3, ... (max 4). The source, reference and element videos must total at most 30s.

items.limit_description: Max file size: 300.0MB, Min width: 700px, Min height: 700px, Max width: 4553px, Max height: 4553px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Min duration: 3.0s, Max duration: 30.05s, Min FPS: 23.9, Max FPS: 60.05, Timeout: 30.0s

video_urls.title: Video Urls

voice_ids.description: Voices referenced in the prompt as @Voice1, @Voice2, ... (max 3, including voices bound to elements). Create one with https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/create-voice
voice_ids.title: Voice Ids

video_url.description:
The video to edit (3-30s), referenced as @Video1.

Max file size: 300.0MB, Min width: 700px, Min height: 700px, Max width: 4553px, Max height: 4553px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Min duration: 3.0s, Max duration: 30.05s, Min FPS: 23.9, Max FPS: 60.05, Timeout: 30.0s
video_url.title: Video Url

prompt.description: Edit instruction. Reference the source video as @Video1.
examples: Change the background to a tropical island at sunset.
prompt.title: Prompt

duration.description: Output duration in seconds (3-30). Defaults to the source video's length.
duration.title: Duration

items.limit_description: Max file size: 30.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

video_url.description: A video of the element, used instead of images (3-8s).

anyOf.limit_description: Max file size: 300.0MB, Min width: 700px, Min height: 700px, Max width: 4553px, Max height: 4553px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Min duration: 3.0s, Max duration: 8.05s, Min FPS: 23.9, Max FPS: 60.05, Timeout: 30.0s

video_url.title: Video Url

voice_id.description: Voice bound to this element. Create one with https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/create-voice
voice_id.title: Voice Id

reference_image_urls.description: Additional views of the element from different angles (1-3).

items.limit_description: Max file size: 30.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls

frontal_image_url.description: The frontal image of the element (main view).

anyOf.limit_description: Max file size: 30.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

frontal_image_url.title: Frontal Image Url

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
